THE E-COMMERCE PERSPECTIVE

Support that continues after the quotation.

Because Huanyue grew from cross-border e-commerce, we understand that a startup brand is solving more than a factory brief. You are choosing the first products, building a position, preparing launch content, controlling cash flow and deciding what to develop next.

We can discuss those decisions with you, share practical experience and coordinate the product work around your commercial plan. The final formula, quotation, documents and production scope are confirmed for each project.

How we work

  1. Share your target market, category, quantity and positioning.
  2. Align the product brief and packaging options.
  3. Review samples and confirm your selection.
  4. Agree the final order, documentation and delivery schedule.
  5. Coordinate production with our manufacturing partner.

Start with the right information

Send your selected product codes, destination country, estimated quantity and packaging preferences. Liam will help organize the next steps.

CASE FORMAT

How a first collection becomes easier to sell.

Brief: a new e-commerce brand wants a skincare hero product with a clear routine extension.

Decision: start with one brightening serum, one barrier cream and one hydration set; keep the first order within the channel’s cash-flow plan.

Execution: align claim language, texture, pack, content angles and replenishment trigger before production.

Learning: sales feedback determines the next SKU instead of adding a large range before product-market fit.
